title: Meeting Mary Nyx

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: So, you’re here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, you’re here.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I know who you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know who you are.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Try not to be so boring. You have become slightly interesting to me. Don’t ruin it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Try not to be so boring. You have become slightly interesting to me. Don’t ruin it.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Indeed. I've heard somewhat intriguing things about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. I've heard somewhat intriguing things about you.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: This isn't just a club. It's a rope to pull yourself out of the gutter. A key to a door that has always been closed to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't just a club. It's a rope to pull yourself out of the gutter. A key to a door that has always been closed to you.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh, you think I need Lims? Adorable. No. It's something more... practical I'm looking for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you think I need Lims? Adorable. No. It's something more... practical I'm looking for.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Names. I want information on anyone who threatens the flow of business in the LUZ. This is my district, after all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Names. I want information on anyone who threatens the flow of business in the LUZ. This is my district, after all.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Shame? I have no use for it. Or for guilt, regret, conscience… they’re nothing more than anchors, tethering us to the muck of others’ emotions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shame? I have no use for it. Or for guilt, regret, conscience… they’re nothing more than anchors, tethering us to the muck of others’ emotions.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You give me, let's say, the names of local agitators and where they can be found and I'll give you a Tier 4 license. Rarer than hen's teeth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You give me, let's say, the names of local agitators and where they can be found and I'll give you a Tier 4 license. Rarer than hen's teeth.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: What do you care? It's a good deal. A little information for a huge reward.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you care? It's a good deal. A little information for a huge reward.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: They won't be sent on an all-inclusive cruise to the Islands, if that's what you're asking. Well?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They won't be sent on an all-inclusive cruise to the Islands, if that's what you're asking. Well?

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You'll give me more than that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll give me more than that.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Spare me your high-mindedness. They made their choices and so have only themselves to blame. I'll give you a chance to change your mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spare me your high-mindedness. They made their choices and so have only themselves to blame. I'll give you a chance to change your mind.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I see that my boy Teleshko was wrong about you. So sad you've chosen to be a failure when you were this close to having it all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see that my boy Teleshko was wrong about you. So sad you've chosen to be a failure when you were this close to having it all.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh, you will be. Count on it. Now get out of my district.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you will be. Count on it. Now get out of my district.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I doubt you'll be breathing anything much longer. Now, get out of my district.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I doubt you'll be breathing anything much longer. Now, get out of my district.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Good. Go ahead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Small fry. Keep going...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Small fry. Keep going...

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Interesting... and one more? Go on, surprise me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting... and one more? Go on, surprise me.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Very good. We have intel on all of them already, of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very good. We have intel on all of them already, of course.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Because playing them the footage of you denouncing them will be TOO delicious. Might be just what we need to break them completely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because playing them the footage of you denouncing them will be TOO delicious. Might be just what we need to break them completely.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: And you're now the owner of a Tier 4 license. Welcome to the Spire club, partner. My endorsement will increase the popularity of all your venues for probably 2 weeks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're now the owner of a Tier 4 license. Welcome to the Spire club, partner. My endorsement will increase the popularity of all your venues for probably 2 weeks.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Hmm. I can see we're going to get along just fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. I can see we're going to get along just fine.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Don't interrupt me! The question is simply: do you have what it takes to accept it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't interrupt me! The question is simply: do you have what it takes to accept it?

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: My dear. That's one of my personal favorites. I can't risk someone running it out of business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My dear. That's one of my personal favorites. I can't risk someone running it out of business.

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You made it up to the big leagues. Don't ruin it now!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You made it up to the big leagues. Don't ruin it now!

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: With this Tier 4 permit some of the most prestigious restaurants and clubs are available to you. I'm watching you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With this Tier 4 permit some of the most prestigious restaurants and clubs are available to you. I'm watching you!

nodes.speaker: Mary-Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You're welcome, dear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome, dear.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: At your invitation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At your invitation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm interested in running this club.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm interested in running this club.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm interested in running this club.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm interested in running this club.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Name your price.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Name your price.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That depends... what do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That depends... what do you want?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That depends... what do you want?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That depends... what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do with them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do with them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will you do with them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will you do with them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will happen to the people I name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will happen to the people I name?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will happen to the people I name?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will happen to the people I name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Done.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will they be hurt?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will they be hurt?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way. Keep your license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way. Keep your license.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll give you two names.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll give you two names.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not happening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not happening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't you have any shame?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you have any shame?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd rather be a failure than end up like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd rather be a failure than end up like you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd rather be a failure than end up like you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd rather be a failure than end up like you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd rather live in the muck than breathe the same air as you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd rather live in the muck than breathe the same air as you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd rather live in the muck than breathe the same air as you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd rather live in the muck than breathe the same air as you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clem Hortelano. Guerilla gardener. She's at the Docks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clem Hortelano. Guerilla gardener. She's at the Docks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Clem Hortelano. Guerilla gardener. She's at the Docks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Clem Hortelano. Guerilla gardener. She's at the Docks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison Mattix. He runs a network that helps debt orphans escape.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison Mattix. He runs a network that helps debt orphans escape.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison Mattix. He runs a network that helps debt orphans escape.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison Mattix. He runs a network that helps debt orphans escape.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then why...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then why...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glad to be of service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad to be of service.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're sick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're sick.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Zaffer. Sign Vandal. Usually found in Lowtown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zaffer. Sign Vandal. Usually found in Lowtown.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Zaffer. Sign Vandal. Usually found in Lowtown.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Zaffer. Sign Vandal. Usually found in Lowtown.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enough of this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enough of this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm supposed to run a club for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm supposed to run a club for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm supposed to run a club for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm supposed to run a club for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like my joint.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like my joint.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Delbert Cherry. Leader of the O.R.S. He's on the Rigs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Delbert Cherry. Leader of the O.R.S. He's on the Rigs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Delbert Cherry. Leader of the O.R.S. He's on the Rigs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Delbert Cherry. Leader of the O.R.S. He's on the Rigs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought I would get the Serpentarium?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought I would get the Serpentarium?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I thought I would get the Serpentarium?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I thought I would get the Serpentarium?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you very much!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you very much!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank for the trust.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank for the trust.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am a great manager!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am a great manager!
